evidence: Has the Build system label and directly alters Guix release toolchains and build scripts under contrib/guix.
rationale: Switching official Linux release binaries to `-static-pie` enables execution across non-glibc distributions like Alpine, simplifies NixOS deployments, and unblocks security hardening such as aarch64 pointer authentication (#19075). It strategically broadens supported release platform targets while fundamentally modifying the Linux release packaging pipeline.
